note: Small area inside a bend of the North River west of Philadelphia, reached by gravel County Road 197, which bridges the river at the north end. There are two primitive camping spots, each beside a small gravel lot off the road. One is on the river bottom near the bridge, with the river behind a tree row across the road. The other is about 1 km south, in a mown field on the hill. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' at two drive-in gravel lots on CR 197 (bottom-land lot = pin, hill lot ~970 m south, same road - no split); free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. The page's 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack' line is the separate walk-in option, not the designated sites. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey)' and 'Designated Camping Sites'. Its description reads 'This area offers walk-in access to the North River but there is no boat ramp.' The 'walk-in' wording is about the river access, and the open/walk camping is MDC's separate backcountry category. The designated sites are the two Primitive Camping symbols on the 9/08 map, each beside a parking lot on gravel CR 197. GIS layer 27 has both (330, 331) and layer 26 has the two lots (100, 101). On imagery both lots are gravel pads, ~12 x 25 m (north) and ~20 x 20 m (south), opening straight off the road, so a 23-ft rig fits. CR 197 crosses the North River on a bridge at the north end (seen on imagery), with no ford, 4WD note or posted limit.
CLUSTER: two spots ~970 m apart on the same road (CR 197) and the same entrance - no split.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): north camp, GIS 331 = pin. The North River (~30 m wide) runs west of CR 197. The lot (100) is ~35 m from the water, and the camping point is ~55-60 m, with the road and a solid tree row on the bank between (0.18 m/px leaf-off frame). There's no open sightline. The south camp is on the hill, ~150 m+ from the river through woods.
PIN: stored 39.83000,-91.78515 = GIS camping point 331, ~30 m into the trees east of lot 100 (39.830374,-91.785378). It's acceptable. Moving it onto the lot is optional.
PHONE: (573) 248-2530 on the area page matches.
